title: Data Sciences, B.S. (Information Sciences and Technology)
notes: Third distinct Data Sciences B.S. program at Penn State (Eberly Science's DS, Engineering's DTSCE, and this one, IST's DATSC) -- each has its own plan code and suggested academic plan. Built the 'Applied Data Sciences Option' (of three IST DS options; the bulletin itself links out to the Computational and Statistical Modeling options as separate pages). Cross-listed picks made for least additional prereq burden, all satisfiable purely from courses already elsewhere in this plan: CMPSC 360 for the 'IST 230/CMPSC 360/MATH 311W' item, STAT 318 for the 'STAT/MATH 318, 414, or 418' item (needs only MATH 141), and IST 445 + DS 402 for the two 'DS 442/IST 442/SODA 308/IST 445/DS 420/DS 441/DS 402/IST 494' picks (IST 445 has zero prereqs; DS 402 needs only DS 220). Bulletin's own 'DS 440 or DS 440W' -- used the real 'DS 440' code (same DS 440W typo already caught building the Engineering DS major). 'Application Focus Selection' (4 items, 12cr total, matching the bulletin's own 'minimum 12 credits' note) has no enumerated course list -- eight named focus areas (Astronomy, Business Fundamentals, Economics, Food Science, Human-Centered Design and Development, Information and Cybersecurity Sciences, Nutrition, Psychology) or a student-proposed custom focus, entirely adviser-driven -- modeled as generic slots, same convention as every other unenumerated elective pool this session. IST 495 (1cr, pass/fail 'SA' grade, 'can be completed at any time before graduation' per its own footnote) placed in Semester 3 as a normal item rather than forced into an actual summer term. UPDATE after the prereq-parser fix: (1) MATH 21 was added (Semester 3, for DS 200's real prereq), which also unblocks STAT 184 (needs MATH 21). Verified against the live bulletin that MATH 21's own enforced prereq ('MATH 4 or satisfactory performance on the mathematics placement examination') is a placement gate, not a literal course requirement, so it's modeled with an empty prereq -- MATH 3/MATH 4 are NOT added here (an earlier pass had added them defensively before this was verified; removed once confirmed unnecessary, since they were the sole cause of a 9th-term overflow). (2) DS 320 and DS 310 both require the literal MATH-prefixed 'MATH 318/414/418' in their real prereq_groups, not the cross-listed STAT 318 -- switched the 'STAT/MATH 318, 414, or 418' item from STAT 318 to MATH 318 (identical course content/prereq, just the department-code half of a cross-listing) so it actually satisfies those two courses' prereqs; this also unblocked DS 340W (needs DS 310) and DS 440 (needs DS 340W).
